integrity: Standalone exact checker tests 4164 complete small directed graphs by coalition marginal enumeration and compares the whole tagged-payoff distribution at rational edge probability; independent scientific validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Uniform trust weights and independent directed arcs only; finite exact representation and sparse/critical limits do not cover general weighted graphs, undirected edges, or normalized Shapley scores. Classical isolate Poisson theorem supplies the final critical-window count; deterministic graphwise Shapley identities are prior work. Equivalent unindexed stochastic treatments are possible.
title: Sparse trust networks: a compound-Poisson Shapley law and a sharp zero-credit threshold
